ops.text: codex refutation prompts phrased 'adversarially verify / try to break / forged manifest' get rejected by OpenAI's cybersecurity classifier (turn.failed 'flagged for possible cybersecurity risk') before any tool use, so targeted refutation lanes silently return fail-with-no-defects. Seen on synckit post-803da5d fixes and reposync verify L1-3 (Runs wf_d7092e6c-714). Workaround: phrase as a correctness review ('check each commit fully resolves the bug it targets, re-run the original scenario, exercise edge cases') and describe the product context (syncing a user's own machines).
